name: @roadmate/ui
description: Design tokens and primitives shared by the three RoadMate apps (HANDOFF §5)

scripts._comment_test: Only `money.js` is tested here — it is the one module that is pure logic and where a bug is silent rather than visible.

_comment_source: Ships uncompiled source. Metro transpiles it through each app's babel config, which is the standard Expo monorepo arrangement and keeps the package free of a build step nobody would remember to run.
